sloka: राघवस्तमुपागम्य तप्यन्तं तप उत्तमम् ।उवाच स तदा वाक्यं धन्यस्त्वमसि सुव्रत ।। ७.७५.१५ ॥
transliteration: rāghavastamupāgamya tapyantaṁ tapa uttamam ।uvāca sa tadā vākyaṁ dhanyastvamasi suvrata ।। 7.75.15 ॥

translations.english: Rama, having approached him who was performing excellent penance, then spoke these words: "O ascetic of good vows, you are blessed."
